text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Certificate/Diploma of highest educationThe certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized4. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.
